description: This file defines a set of simple-methods for content management within the Apache OFBiz framework, including methods for creating, updating, associating, and creating document trees for content.

methods.name: createContentAndPurpose
methods.description: Creates a new Content object, sets its dates, optionally creates a related ContentPurpose, and handles permissions.

methods.name: updateContent
methods.description: Updates existing Content object fields, including date conversions and related ContentPurpose list.

methods.name: addContentAssoc
methods.description: Establishes an association between two content entities, linking article to publish point.

methods.name: createDocument
methods.description: Creates a hierarchical document tree by creating content and linking it via content associations.
